note: [L] interpolates at 301 fixed nodes in `sun` (`i/301`) and states the bound in stencil (`sanction`) form, so no finite-difference recovery of coefficients is needed. [M] uses nodes in `[-1,1]` and coefficient sums.

snippet.text: def sphere (q s t : ℝ): Prop:= 0<t ∧ 2≤q ∧ 0<s ∧ s ≤1 ∧ ∃ u:ℝ, 0≤u∧ u*t*6 ≤ s ∧ ∀ (G:Gauge) (c:Side)(P:BudgetPoint) (A:ℕ→RegularAddress c) (F:sun→ℕ→ Config G c→ℝ) (v b B:ℝ),q≤v→sanction P A F v B→ (∀ t,Meadow.Budget P A (F t) b) → sanction P A F q (u*b+(1+u)*(q/v)^(301:ℕ)*B)

proof_context.conclusion: `sphere q s t` packages a constant `u` with `sanction ... q (u*b+(1+u)*(q/v)^301*B)` from `sanction v B` and budget `b` at the real nodes.

lemma squeeze (q:ℝ) (hq:1≤q):∃ u:ℝ,0≤u∧∀ (G:Gauge)(c:Side)(P:BudgetPoint)(A:ℕ→RegularAddress c)(X:sun→ℕ→ Config G c→ℝ)(v b B:ℝ),q≤v→sanction P A X v B→ (∀ t,Meadow.Budget P A (X t) b)→ sanction P A X q (u*b+(1+u)*(q/v)^(k+1)*B):=by
  obtain ⟨u,hu,h⟩:= toys k (sampleP k) q hq
  exact ⟨_,sum_nonneg (fun i (_:i∈ univ)=> hu i),fun _ _ _ _ X _ _ _ he hp hX=> squeeze_core k (sampleP k) X q u hu (samples_in k) hq h he hp hX⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Interpolating at `k+1 = 301` fixed nodes, `k=300`, gives a constant `u` independent of gauge, volume and coupling.
